> # PURESCRAP Newsletter No. 7
>
> - Title: PURESCRAP Newsletter No. 7

>
> ## Verified deployment progress
>
> - The June 2026 newsletter says the heavy-scrap sensor station was moved in
>   April from Swerim in Luleå to Stena Recycling's Hallstahammar production
>   site after testing at Swerim.
> - The consortium describes the move as progress toward full industrial
>   operation, not as confirmation that full industrial operation has begun.
> - The newsletter also says the LIBS sensor was refined to improve performance
>   with surface contamination and describes AI work for identifying copper
>   components in scrap.
>
> ## Cross-check and interpretation boundary
>
> - The February 2026 steering-committee notice
>   (SRC-20260728-71F1636F) said recent test-campaign results were still being
>   evaluated and another experiment phase was being prepared.
> - The European Commission CORDIS results record
>   (SRC-20260728-E41E2371) separately lists intermediate KPI and melting reports,
>   rather than a final KPI evaluation.
> - The newsletter therefore supports a later equipment-relocation and
>   pre-industrial deployment milestone. It does not disclose quantified LIBS
>   accuracy, copper-removal efficiency, throughput, uptime, steel-quality
>   results, CO2 reduction, or attainment of the project's 40% scrap-share
>   target.
